## Goal
distro/CHECKLIST.md: one table per channel (aur, flatpak, homebrew, nix, scoop, winget) listing every placeholder hash, version, URL or source: file:line, what replaces it, who does it (in-house release tooling or a maintainer), and the state 'coming' until site_src/data/release.yaml says otherwise.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Every FIXME/TODO/placeholder in distro/ appears in the table (read all six channels).
- Commands that were not run are labelled unverified; the Flatpak pip-sources row says it needs network.
- No packaging/ edits.
- `PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/copilot/` still passes (your shell may be refused; then say so).
- No real personal data; examples use Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL.
- Create no files outside the allowed paths.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- distro/CHECKLIST.md
- VENDOR_STATUS.md

## Out of scope / do not touch
Every other file. src/ is read-only.

## Check-in plan
VENDOR_STATUS.md when done; Grace summarises in COPILOT_TO_CLAUDE.md. Tracker issue: FreeMyID/freemyid-pm (Morgan mirrors).
